commands: sh -c "test -r /etc/ssh/sshd_config || exit 1; grep -i StrictModes /etc/ssh/sshd_config | grep -v '^#' || echo STRICTMODES_ABSENT"
blurb: This check verifies that the SSH daemon performs StrictModes checking of home-directory configuration files so unauthorized users cannot plant or alter those files to hijack sessions.
